parameters.jsCode: const results=$('Research Market').first().json?.results||[];const input=$('Validate Input').first().json;const marketContext=results.map(r=>r.title+': '+(r.content||r.snippet||'').slice(0,400)).join('\n');return[{json:{input,marketContext:marketContext||'No market data found — rely on bottom-up estimation.'}}];

values.content: You build market sizing models for startups and investors. Good market sizing: uses both top-down (TAM from industry reports) and bottom-up (units × price) approaches; is honest about uncertainty ranges; explains the assumptions; identifies what would make the numbers larger or smaller; and gives a realistic serviceable addressable market, not just the biggest number. Always respond in valid JSON only.
